brief: Website for our tennis club in Izmir (Urla). 8 clay courts, coaching for kids and adults. We need membership plans with prices and an online member sign up form. Elegant, green.

sections.goal: Club logo, Courts, Membership, Coaching, Join links, mobile ☰ menu
Full-bleed clay court image with the club's founding year and Become a Member button
8 clay courts, 2 floodlit, clubhouse, pro shop and junior academy
Junior €40, Individual €95 and Family €180 monthly plans, yearly prices, court booking and coaching discounts, Join buttons to the sign up form
Weekly group coaching table for juniors, beginners and advanced adults
Member sign up form: full name, email, phone, plan, password, password again, consent checkbox and a log in link
Club name, address, opening hours and copyright year
